erc.weighting: long-only equal risk contribution; normalize to 0.55 then clip each at 0.10; no redistribution

clustered.clustering: deterministic connected components; highest V3 rank per cluster; V3-rank refill

dispersion.gate: global forward-alpha bucket means monotonic and monotonic in a strict majority of eligible six-month folds

factor_etf.panel_limitation: IWM, MTUM, QUAL, VLUE and USMV are absent from the canonical v5 bars

twice_weekly.execution: completed daily bar, next tradable bar fill

blocked.pead: No announcement timestamp, actual EPS, pre-announcement consensus, revision lineage, or typed PointInTimeFeatureView exists in the repository
blocked.composite: Run only after a standalone second leg passes positive economics, 3x cost, jackknife, multi-fold incrementality, and active-return correlation below 0.60
